prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Over the scene lies the fine engraved line work of a banknote: hair-thin curving parallel lines and rosettes in money-green and copper ink, wrapping round every contour like a contour map. Camera low at the edge of a floury wooden table, a mound of dough huge in the foreground. Bakers in vests knead dough at 4 a.m. in a basement kitchen, flour hanging in the air; nearest the camera, a heavy-set Black man in his fifties with a shaved head, a broken nose and a double chin, in a sweat-stained vest, flour on his forearms, his face large, eyes wet and tired. Light: the open mouth of a brick oven at the back throws hot orange light across their arms; one bare bulb; the rest falls to deep brown shadow. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
